title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix X is constructed using dummy variables for each food item. Each column represents a food, and each row represents a student's lunch on a particular day. If a food is eaten, the corresponding entry is 1; otherwise, it's $$0$$.

title: Full Column Rank
text: For a matrix to be full column rank, its columns must be linearly independent. This means no column can be written as a linear combination of the others.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Consider the columns of the design matrix. Are there any columns that can be expressed as a combination of others?

title: Implications of Full Column Rank
text: If the design matrix X is full column rank, it implies that the columns are linearly independent, which affects the uniqueness of the solution in ordinary least squares regression.
